topic: Splitting rent unevenly by room size
core_question: Two roommates split $1,200 in rent so that one pays 60% and the other pays 40%, since one has the larger room. How much does the person with the larger room pay? (secondary: A phone charges at a rate of 20% every 15 minutes. Find how many minutes it takes to charge from 40% to 100%.)
answer_summary: the larger share of $720 (60% of $1,200 rent); after the topic shift: the total of 45 minutes (charging from 40% to 100% at 20% per 15 minutes)
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there
